# ArSee · Open-Source IEC 60870-5-101/103/104 Protocol Tester & Analyzer

Free Apache-2.0 Windows IEC 60870-5-101, IEC 60870-5-103 and IEC 60870-5-104 tester and evidence analyzer. Inspect original TX/RX frames, supported values/events, findings and native PDF reports. Not a production SCADA or certified IEC conformance suite.

## Published builds
- Latest public stable v3.6.14: https://github.com/masarray/ARIEC60870/releases/tag/v3.6.14
- Windows installer: https://github.com/masarray/ARIEC60870/releases/download/v3.6.14/ARIEC60870-v3.6.14-setup-win-x64.exe
- Windows portable ZIP: https://github.com/masarray/ARIEC60870/releases/download/v3.6.14/ARIEC60870-v3.6.14-win-x64.zip
- Previous stable v3.6.13: https://github.com/masarray/ARIEC60870/releases/tag/v3.6.13
- Exact-source public package: https://github.com/masarray/ARIEC60870/actions/runs/44049527667
- Source Windows CI, WPF acceptance and native updater FAT: https://github.com/masarray/ARIEC60870/actions/runs/44048682483
- Unmerged historic IEC-101 engine draft PR #145 remains excluded.

## v3.6.14 improvements
- IEC-101/104 measured values can be projected with explicit Factor/Ratio/Offset or bipolar TwoPoint X0/X100/Y0/Y100 from trusted decoded sources, retaining original bytes and quality.
- 31 source-derived IEC-101 SCADA I/O names use BAY TYPE + TYPE + MNEMO + optional LAB number; exact CA/IOA/TI identity is required.
- TI9 POAQ normalized 0..1000 follows the documented source; TI13 float remains identity if RTU already transmits MW. Unverified TI11 Q signed integers remain counts until field calibration.
- User-owned profiles can be explicitly reconciled via Signal List -> Sync 31 I/O and Save As, without overwriting command/feedback, CA or calibrated engineering values.
- Preserves earlier IEC-101 single/A-B reliability, GI/SBO evidence, IEC-104 GI and event-log performance, with actual physical RTU FAT still separate.

## Evidence boundary
An addressed link response is not always an accepted application ASDU. GI is not proof every point was received. HOLD pins only the displayed viewport, not recording. Unverified IEC-101 balanced mode or physical multi-vendor FAT must not be claimed.
